datasets.citation: Horst AM, Hill AP, Gorman KB (2020). palmerpenguins: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) penguin data. doi:10.5281/zenodo.3960218. Original observations: Gorman KB, Williams TD, Fraser WR (2014), PLoS ONE 9(3):e90081, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0090081; Palmer Station Antarctica LTER and K. Gorman.
limitations: Adult sampled penguins near Palmer Station; not a random sample of all penguins.
Simplified table lacks nest identifiers; independence is approximate.
Missing entries are preserved as NA; integer/decimal storage is not an instrument-error model.
datasets.additional_use_guidance: The maintainer asks researchers planning publication to contact Kristen Gorman and follow LTER data-use guidance. This local teaching redistribution preserves that request; no contact or external publication was made.

datasets.citation: Chen, S. (2017). Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI 10.24432/C5RK5G. Air quality: Beijing Municipal Environmental Monitoring Center; weather: China Meteorological Administration.

columns.name: station
columns.description: Exact UCI monitoring-site name; twelve values.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Every 2016 calendar date; no timezone conversion assumed.

columns.name: n_hours
columns.description: Number of source hourly rows on this date.

columns.name: n_pm25
columns.description: Hours with nonmissing finite PM2.5, including zero if recorded.

columns.name: n_wspm
columns.description: Hours with nonmissing finite wind speed, including calm zero.

columns.name: n_pair
columns.description: Hours with both PM2.5 and wind present; same hours for both daily means.

columns.name: pm25_ug_m3
columns.description: Arithmetic mean of source PM2.5 over paired hours, NA if none; no offset or clipping.

columns.name: wspm_m_s
columns.description: Arithmetic mean of source WSPM over the same paired hours, NA if none.

columns.name: eligible_18
columns.description: One if n_pair >= 18; frozen base eligibility, not an environmental standard.

columns.name: eligible_24
columns.description: One if n_pair == 24; completeness sensitivity, not an environmental standard.

columns.name: split
columns.description: Identifier-hash selection made before pollutant inspection; Dongsi/Guanyuan final, other ten training.

transformations: Select source year 2016, retain 366 dates at each of twelve sites.
Aggregate both variables over paired finite hours; retain missing and ineligible rows.
Freeze base and alternative completeness at >=18 and ==24 paired hours.
Keep zero as an observation; negative/unexplained nonfinite source values fail acquisition.
Model transforms are separate: log concentration/reference unit 1 ug/m3 and base-training population-SD wind standardization.
exclusions: Ineligible rows are retained with flags and do not contribute to the corresponding fit/score.
limitations: Nearest-station weather can be shared across monitoring sites.
Available-hour means need not equal complete-day exposures; missingness may be informative.
Target is historical conditional prediction, not forecasting, causality or exposure.
Source recorded calendar preserved; timezone conversion not established.
